children: MCD unveiled >NEXT: target low‑mid 50% operating margins by 2030, ~250bp restaurant-level efficiency, ~1.5pp market-share gains in chicken/beverages, $8.5B NEXT support through 2036, ~4‑yr paybacks
McDonald’s (MCD) announced $8.5B in financial support for franchisees, including about $5B in rent relief and capital through 2030, with additional franchisee support commitments extending to 2036.
McDonald's plans its own media network after testing digital ads on 450 U.S. company drive-thrus. Execs cite ~85% U.S. customer reach, national footprint and potential for sizeable ad revenue.
McDonald's (MCD) unveiled NEXT: simplify operations, modernize restaurants, expand staff training and roll out ArchIQ AI for drive‑thru automation to boost efficiency and restaurant cash flow.
McDonald's (MCD) shares slid ~5–6% after investor day, trading near four‑year lows at $234.88. Company disclosed an $8.5B franchisee support plan; stock eyed a seventh straight weekly drop.
After McDonald's investor day, UBS cut MCD price target to $320, Citi to $310, Morgan Stanley to $308; Seaport Global started Neutral, saying noticeable improvement may not arrive until mid‑2027.
McDonald’s (MCD) says traffic in key markets could stay flat; it’s investing to help franchisees offset rising costs and boost sales and profitability amid near-term traffic headwinds.
McDonald's (MCD): CFO Ian Borden said U.S. same-store sales were slightly negative in July‑August, expects a positive September, but Q3 U.S. sales are projected to stay negative.
McDonald's (MCD) Q report: revenue +4% y/y, adjusted EPS +6%, global comps +1.3%, U.S. comps +0.8%; noted higher average checks despite slower sales pace.
McDonald's plans a tiered loyalty program: ~220M active members split into frequent and 90-day tiers with faster points, early access and events; ~150M lapsed members get re-engagement offers.
